test_knn_points_naive: test the naive KNN implementation by computing nearest neighbors between two point clouds with configurable K and norm
test_knn_vs_python_square: test knn_points against the naive implementation using square-shaped point clouds on CPU or CUDA devices
test_knn_vs_python_ragged: test knn_points against the naive implementation using ragged point clouds with variable lengths per batch
test_knn_gather: test knn_gather to retrieve nearest neighbor point values from source point cloud using KNN indices
test_knn_check_version: test knn_check_version to verify which KNN algorithm version supports given dimension and K parameters
